title: Lebanon's Salam calls for faster Israeli withdrawal at US envoy meeting
gist: A short Al-Monitor Brief podcast segment notes the UAE accused Iran of targeting two of its tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, and that Turkey is expected to sign the charter for the Saudi-led naval coalition in the Red Sea.

insights.so_what: Turkey's formal accession to the Saudi-led Red Sea coalition would expand the coalition's membership and naval capacity against Houthi shipping attacks.
